notes.title: After the 100% Kickstarter, the Steam page is up !
notes.content:
[h1]What an achievement ![/h1]

I started this project couple of months ago and published a [b]Kickstarter[/b] 2 months ago, that was successfully funded 1 month ago (thank you, everyone!). Now the Steam page has been put up in anticipation and to hype all of you (and me of course!)

I hope that some Steam users are going to Follow Perfect Murder, please add it to your Wishlist!

Demo will come soon, it will be an upgraded one since the Kickstarter. Might be out before September if there isn't any huge issues!

Once again, thanks for the support!

Feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/v3tEFyt]join our Discord[/url] !
